question: Which Constitutional amendment added the words, Socialist and Secular in the Preamble?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Forty-Second Amendment Act, 1976**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **With the passage of the 42nd Constitutional Amendment **in **1976**, the words **"Socialist," "Secular," and "Integrity" **were added to the **Preamble of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• The **Preamble **is crucial in **determining the course of the nation**.
 
• It **provides a small glimpse **into the **constitution's authors' thoughts**.
 
• It **comprises **the **guiding principles **upon which the **entire Constitution is based**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Secular meaning **in **preamble **is that the **relationship between the government and religious groups **are **determined according to the constitution and law**. It **separates the power of the state and religion**.
 
• According to **socialist theory, the government is accountable to its citizens for their wellbeing**, the **abolition of discrimination**, the **nationalisation **of the **means of production**, the **equitable distribution of wealth**, and **the maintenance of justice for all**.
